summary: Calculates session-specific exponential decay constants from neural GLMs and behavioral action kernels, then quantifies their alignment using Pearson correlation.
use_when: calculate neural versus behavioral decay constant correlation
estimate tau parameters from neural activity and behavior
how does neural history integration compare to behavioral action kernels?
compute pearson correlation of inverse decay constants across recording sessions
analyze trial-history dependence timescales in neural and behavioral data
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
